name: Spellcasting
description: Cast Ranger spells using Wisdom. Prepare 2 spells of level 1. Spells that a feature always prepares do not count against these choices. After a Long Rest, you can replace one prepared spell. You can use a Druidic Focus as your spellcasting focus.

descriptions.2: Cast Ranger spells using Wisdom. Prepare 3 spells of level 1. Spells that a feature always prepares do not count against these choices. After a Long Rest, you can replace one prepared spell. You can use a Druidic Focus as your spellcasting focus.
descriptions.3: Cast Ranger spells using Wisdom. Prepare 4 spells of level 1. Spells that a feature always prepares do not count against these choices. After a Long Rest, you can replace one prepared spell. You can use a Druidic Focus as your spellcasting focus.

name: Weapon Mastery
description: Your training allows you to use the mastery property of 2 weapons you are proficient with. You can change which weapons you use this with after a Long Rest. See Weapon Mastery cards for property details.

name: Deft Explorer
description: Gain Expertise in one of your skill proficiencies that lacks it. Learn two languages of your choice.

name: Fighting Style
description: Choose a Fighting Style feat. Alternatively, Druidic Warrior teaches two Druid cantrips using Wisdom; replace one when you gain a Ranger level.

name: Hunter's Lore
description: While a creature is marked by your Hunter's Mark, you know its Immunities, Resistances, and Vulnerabilities, if any.

name: Hunter's Prey
description: Choose after a Short or Long Rest: Colossus Slayer deals an extra 1d8 weapon damage once per turn to a target missing HP. Horde Breaker lets you make one extra attack per turn with the same weapon against another creature within 5 feet of the first, within range, that you have not attacked this turn.
